scoring_scope: Repository and runtime-readiness evidence for the True Autonomous Controller, not a claim that every production live gate has been exhausted.

sectors.name: Telegram command intake and operator UX
sectors.reason: Telegram /work, /queue, /handoff, /status, and Korean receipt/final report paths exist and have live smoke history.
sectors.remaining_risk: Needs more long-run user-origin command samples across real project types.

sectors.name: n8n orchestration layer
sectors.reason: Active command workflow and inactive runtime orchestration drafts exist; draft import and queue routing have been validated.
sectors.remaining_risk: Old n8n node-shape warnings should be cleaned when production workflow maintenance is approved.

sectors.name: Queue and state persistence
sectors.reason: SQLite queue writer, queue schema, state schema, handoff endpoint, sample state, continuation ledger, and lock-protected pending queue writes are present.
sectors.remaining_risk: Longer queue retention and compaction policy can still be added, but the main race-risk gap now has a local lock and SQLite immediate transaction.

sectors.name: tmux and runtime runner execution
sectors.reason: tmux templates, company-mode runner, remote queue smoke, runtime engine smoke, and lock-protected dequeue template exist.
sectors.remaining_risk: 5-6 hour unattended soak remains the main hardening gate.

sectors.name: Codex execution and sandbox isolation
sectors.reason: Docker runner image and no-network Codex CLI smoke are present, with host fallback explicitly gated.
sectors.remaining_risk: Real containerized Codex task execution still needs Docker-only auth volume setup.

sectors.name: Reviewer, retry, and escalation loop
sectors.reason: Reviewer feedback schema, reviewer loop template, retry smoke, deferred gate handling, and phase3 orchestrator exist.
sectors.remaining_risk: Independent LLM reviewer quality is still scaffolded rather than fully production-proven.

sectors.name: Safety, rollback, and kill switch
sectors.reason: Hard safety rules, kill switch template, git checkpoint manifest, no-secret defaults, deferred gates, and service kill-switch narrowing are stored.
sectors.remaining_risk: Automatic pre-run/post-pass Git commits per arbitrary target workspace remain policy-gated.

sectors.name: Telemetry and auditability
sectors.reason: Runtime event schema, JSONL telemetry sample, execution logs, patch history, and generated scorecard create deterministic audit trails.
sectors.remaining_risk: A dashboard can be added later, but append-only audit foundations are strong.

sectors.name: Operator documentation and multilingual README policy
sectors.reason: This run adds a unified README and permanent five-language README policy in project boot rules.
sectors.remaining_risk: Future README edits must keep the policy enforced by tests.

sectors.name: Long-run continuation readiness
sectors.reason: Continuation ledger, handoff endpoint, queue soak test, runtime state model, and exact resume prompts exist.
sectors.remaining_risk: A real 5-6 hour overnight soak has not yet been completed.

remaining_deferred_gates: Docker-only Codex auth volume for real containerized Codex tasks
automatic Git commit policy for arbitrary target workspaces
production workflow maintenance and activation changes
implemented_gap_fixes: Added root README with five-language operator instructions.
Stored permanent five-language README policy in AGENTS.md and SESSION_BOOT.md.
Added reproducible 10-sector scorecard generator and schema.
Added queue locking and SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction for pending queue writes.
Added flock/mkdir lock protection to the tmux runner dequeue template.
Narrowed service kill switch to TAC tmux sessions and intentionally removed process-wide pkill.
Changed host Codex fallback default to disabled; Docker-first remains preferred.
Changed TAC service startup default sandbox from danger-full-access to workspace-write.
Added regression tests for scorecard, multilingual README policy, runner safety, and queue locking.
